lines.reference: Spinach, raw — USDA FDC 168462 (morogo / spinach leaves): 23 kcal / 100 g
Oil, sunflower, linoleic (less than 60%) — USDA FDC 171017: 884 kcal / 100 g
Onions, raw — USDA FDC 170000: 40 kcal / 100 g
Garlic, raw — USDA FDC 169230: 149 kcal / 100 g
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average — USDA FDC 170457: 18 kcal / 100 g
Peppers, hot chili, green, raw — USDA FDC 170497: 40 kcal / 100 g
Spices, pepper, black — USDA FDC 170931 — none counted

notes: Assumptions that change the number: 600 g leaves after the stalks are off, at the USDA raw spinach value (wild morogo greens are similar); both tbsp of oil eaten; medium onion 150 g, tomatoes 120 g each. Sanity check: plain cooked spinach is 23 kcal / 100 g (USDA FDC 168463), so the greens, onion and tomato are ~250 kcal for the pot; the oil (239 kcal) is half the energy, giving ~120 kcal for a ~250 g side portion. The web search budget ran out before a published morogo figure could be found.
